vehicleDetails.title: Punch New EV
vehicleDetails.description: The Tata Punch EV 2026 lineup sets a new benchmark for electric micro-SUVs in India, offering a versatile range of 7 distinct variants built on the high-tech Acti.ev platform. Whether you prioritize the revolutionary Battery-as-a-Service (BaaS) model for an ultra-affordable entry price of ₹6.49 Lakh, or the premium Long Range (40kWh) battery pack with a class-leading 468 km certified range, there is a configuration tailored for every urban commuter. From the safety-focused Smart base trim to the feature-loaded Empowered Plus S with its voice-assisted sunroof and ventilated seats, the Punch EV combines 5-star safety, dual battery options (30kWh & 40kWh), and advanced tech like 360-degree cameras to deliver the ultimate value-for-money electric driving experience.

variantData.title: Punch EV Smart 30 kWh
variantData.description:
The Tata Punch EV Smart 30kWh is redefining the entry-level electric SUV segment in India. Built on the revolutionary Acti.ev (Advanced Connected Tech-Intelligent Electric Vehicle) architecture, this variant is designed for those who demand uncompromising SUV styling with class-leading electric efficiency.

Certified Range and Battery Performance

One of the most compelling reasons to choose the Smart trim is its impressive MIDC certified range of 375 km on a single charge. Powered by a robust 30kWh Lithium-ion battery pack, it offers the perfect balance for both daily city commutes and occasional weekend getaways without the constant need for a charger.

variantData.title: Punch EV Smart Plus 40 kWh
variantData.description:
The Tata Punch EV Smart Plus 40kWh is the definitive choice for those who want the compact agility of a micro-SUV without compromising on highway capability. Built on the Acti.ev platform, this "Long Range" version of the Smart Plus trim offers a superior driving range and enhanced performance.

Extended Range and Powerful Performance

The highlight of this variant is the 40kWh high-energy-density battery pack. It is designed for drivers who have longer daily commutes or enjoy weekend road trips, significantly reducing the frequency of charging stops.

  • Battery Capacity: 40kWh Lithium-ion
  • Certified Range: 468 km (MIDC)
  • Performance: Higher power output (approx. 122 PS) compared to the 30kWh variants, offering quicker 0-100 km/h sprints and better highway overtakes.

Premium Features of the Smart Plus Trim

Despite being a mid-tier trim, the Smart Plus 40kWh comes packed with technology and comfort features that elevate the driving experience:

  • Connectivity: Touchscreen infotainment system with Wireless Android Auto & Apple CarPlay.
  • Comfort: Steering-mounted controls, automatic climate control, and all-four power windows.
  • Convenience: Paddle shifters for multi-mode regeneration, allowing you to control energy recovery on the fly.

Safety and Architecture

Like all Punch EVs, the 40kWh Smart Plus is built with a focus on safety and structural integrity.

  • Safety Suite: 6 Airbags, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), Hill Hold Control, and disc brakes on all four wheels (exclusive to Long Range variants).
  • Architecture: The Acti.ev platform ensures a flat floor for rear passengers and optimized battery placement for a lower center of gravity.

Why Upgrade to the 40kWh Variant?

The Tata Punch EV Smart Plus 40kWh price offers incredible value for buyers seeking a long-range EV under ₹12 Lakh. It provides the peace of mind of a 468 km range, making it a viable primary vehicle for most Indian households.

variantData.title: Punch EV Adventure 40 kWh
variantData.description:
The Tata Punch EV Adventure 40kWh is the perfect companion for those who seek excitement beyond the city limits. Combining the robust Acti.ev platform with a high-capacity battery, this variant is built for longevity, performance, and a touch of ruggedness that defines the "Adventure" persona.

Superior Long Range Performance

The 40kWh Lithium-ion battery pack is the heart of this vehicle, providing an impressive certified range of 468 km (MIDC). With a more powerful 90 kW motor compared to the 30kWh variants, the Adventure trim offers brisk acceleration and confident highway cruising.

  • Battery: 40kWh High-Density Battery
  • Range: 468 km (Certified)
  • Power: Approx. 122 PS for a spirited driving experience.
  • Drive Modes: Multi-mode regenerative braking with paddle shifters.

The "Adventure" Edge

As the name suggests, this trim is geared towards a more active lifestyle, featuring functional and aesthetic upgrades:

  • Technology: 17.78 cm (7-inch) Touchscreen Infotainment by HARMAN with Android Auto & Apple CarPlay.
  • Comfort: Push-button start/stop, electrically adjustable ORVMs, and a height-adjustable driver seat.
  • Utility: High ground clearance and a muscular SUV design that handles rough patches with ease.

5-Star Safety Pedigree

Safety is paramount in the Adventure 40kWh, which carries forward Tata's legacy of building tough vehicles.

  • Core Safety: 6 Airbags, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), and ISOFIX mounts as standard.
  • Long Range Exclusives: Disc brakes on all four wheels and an Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) with Auto Hold, ensuring superior stopping power and convenience in traffic.

Why the Adventure 40kWh?

Priced at approximately ₹11.59 Lakh (ex-showroom), the Tata Punch EV Adventure 40kWh offers the best of both worlds: the extensive range needed for highway travel and the rugged features needed for an adventurous lifestyle. It is the go-to variant for buyers who don't want to be limited by charging stops.

variantData.title: Punch EV Empowered 40 kWh
variantData.description:
The Tata Punch EV Empowered 40kWh is designed for those who want the best-in-class features without compromising on the efficiency of an electric drivetrain. As the high-spec variant built on the Acti.ev platform, the Empowered trim offers a sophisticated driving experience with long-range capabilities and a premium cabin.

Elite Long Range Capability

Powered by the 40kWh high-energy-density battery pack, the Empowered variant delivers a certified MIDC range of 468 km. This ensures that you can handle long highway drives and busy city weeks with absolute confidence.

  • Battery: 40kWh Lithium-ion pack.
  • Range: 468 km (MIDC Certified).
  • Power & Torque: 122 PS and 190 Nm, providing effortless overtakes and a smooth, silent ride.
  • Charging: Supports DC fast charging, taking you from 10% to 80% in approximately 56 minutes.

Sophisticated "Empowered" Features

The Empowered trim stands out with its focus on luxury and high-end technology:

  • Interior: Premium dual-tone interiors with leatherette upholstery and a leather-wrapped steering wheel.
  • Tech: A larger 26.03 cm (10.25-inch) Touchscreen Infotainment system by HARMAN and a fully digital instrument cluster.
  • Visibility: 360-degree Surround View Camera system and Blind Spot View Monitor for effortless parking and safety.
  • Comfort: Ventilated front seats (optional/S variant) and an air purifier with AQI display.

Safety and Stability

Built with a 5-star safety pedigree, the Empowered 40kWh includes high-end safety tech:

  • Braking: Disc brakes on all four wheels for superior control.
  • Convenience: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) with Auto Hold and a jeweled rotary gear selector with a digital display.
  • Standard Safety: 6 Airbags, ESC, and ISOFIX child seat mounts.

Why Choose the Empowered 40kWh?

Priced at approximately ₹12.29 Lakh (ex-showroom), the Tata Punch EV Empowered 40kWh is the ideal choice for tech-savvy buyers who want a premium, feature-rich SUV that can also serve as their primary vehicle for long-distance travel.

variantData.title: Punch EV Empowered Plus S 40 kWh

Under the hood, the Empowered Plus S features the most capable powertrain in the range. The 40kWh battery pack offers a class-leading certified MIDC range of 468 km, making it perfectly suitable for both dense city traffic and long-distance interstate travel.

  • Drive Experience: High-performance motor delivering 122 PS and instant torque, paired with multi-mode regenerative braking and paddle shifters.
  • Fast Charging: Can be charged from 10% to 80% in just 56 minutes using a 50 kW DC fast charger.

  • Infotainment: A massive 26.03 cm (10.25-inch) HD Touchscreen by HARMAN with Wireless Android Auto & Apple CarPlay.
  • Audio: Premium cinematic sound experience with 4 speakers and 4 tweeters.
  • Comfort: Ventilated front seats for maximum comfort in Indian summers, plus an integrated air purifier.

Advanced Safety & Driving Aids

Safety is elevated to a professional level in this top-end variant:

  • 360° Vision: 360-degree Surround View Camera and Blind Spot View Monitor for ultimate visibility.
  • Braking: All-wheel disc brakes for superior stopping power and Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) with Auto Hold.
  • Standard Safety: 6 Airbags, ISOFIX mounts, and Electronic Stability Control (ESC).

Why Choose the Empowered Plus S 40kWh?

Priced at approximately ₹12.59 Lakh (ex-showroom), the Tata Punch EV Empowered Plus S 40kWh is the complete package. It is the best choice for enthusiasts who want a primary electric vehicle that offers a sunroof, high-tech interiors, and enough range to tackle any journey with peace of mind.

variantData.title: Punch EV  BaaS
variantData.description:
The Tata Punch EV Smart 30kWh BaaS model is designed to make electric mobility more accessible than ever before. By decoupling the cost of the battery from the vehicle, Tata Motors allows you to own a high-tech electric micro-SUV at a fraction of the traditional upfront price. Under the Battery-as-a-Service (BaaS) program, you pay for the car and subscribe to the battery usage.

Understanding the BaaS Advantage

The primary draw of this variant is the reduced ex-showroom price, which starts at approximately ₹6.49 Lakh. This makes the Punch EV comparable in price to many entry-level petrol hatchbacks, while still offering all the benefits of an electric powertrain.

  • Upfront Savings: Lower initial purchase cost by removing the battery price.
  • Subscription Model: Pay a nominal fee per kilometer for battery usage, ensuring you only pay for what you drive.
  • Peace of Mind: The battery remains under the manufacturer’s care, often coming with lifetime warranties or easy replacement options under the service agreement.

Performance and Range Essentials

Despite the different ownership model, the vehicle's performance remains uncompromised. It utilizes the same 30kWh battery technology found in the standard Smart trim.

  • Certified Range: 351 km (MIDC).
  • Power: Reliable performance from a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor.
  • Charging: Fully compatible with home AC charging and public DC fast chargers.

Standard Smart Features

The BaaS model retains all the essential features of the "Smart" trim:

  • Safety: 6 Airbags, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), and ABS with EBD.
  • Design: Rugged SUV looks with a high ground clearance and modern LED lighting.
  • Interior: Practical cabin with a digital instrument cluster and essential driver aids.

Is the Punch EV BaaS Right for You?

The Tata Punch EV Smart 30kWh BaaS is perfect for budget-conscious buyers and high-mileage city drivers. It removes the "EV tax" on the initial purchase price, making it an excellent entry point into sustainable transportation without a large financial commitment.
